messages.author: 5f1957cb9553c863
messages.subject: Print specific PC scores
parts:
Hi, 
I was wondering if there was a way to print specific PC Scores. When I use mydata.pca[["pc.scores"]] the output is too much information to all be printed on the Rstudio console so I cannot see the first 24 PC Scores. I figured there must be a way to only print PC1 but I can't seem to figure it out.
Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Print specific PC scores
parts:
Example:

 

data(plethspecies)

Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethspecies$land)   

PCA <- gm.prcomp(Y.gpa$coords)

PCA$x[,1]

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Print specific PC scores
parts:
The part in Dean’s message that was important was the [,1].  Tables, matrices, data frames, and arrays in R use the brackets and commas to specify locations.  Something like, [5,] means the fifth row and something like [, 8] means the eighth column.  So if you can get to the pc.scores in your plotTangentSpace object, then tacking on [, 1:5] at the end will reduce it to the first 5 components.

More info found here: https://www.statmethods.net/management/subset.html

Mike
